## Summary

The issue was that the pytz timezone data files in `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/pytz/zoneinfo/` were corrupted. All 598 timezone files had been replaced with files containing only the text "CORRUPTED" (10 bytes each), instead of valid timezone binary data.

The fix was to:

This restored proper timezone functionality for pandas datetime operations, and all previously failing tests now pass.
